1706.03762.title: Attention Is All You Need
1706.03762.abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

qas.question: How many layers are stacked in the Transformer encoder?

answer.free_form_answer: The encoder consists of a stack of N = 6 identical layers.
evidence: 3.1 Encoder and Decoder Stacks:::The encoder is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers.

qas.question: Why does Multi-Head Attention perform better than single attention?

answer.free_form_answer: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.
evidence: 3.2.2 Multi-Head Attention:::Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

qas.question: Does the Transformer use any recurrent connections?

extractive_spans: dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely
answer.free_form_answer: No, it dispenses with recurrence entirely.
evidence: 1 Introduction:::We propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism.
